provenance: Community references and game-extracted database; console build not independently verified. Live evidence overrides predictions.

rules.statement: Use current named cards, costs, intents, inventory and counters. Unknown fields stay unknown; re-observe after a material change.
Corruption makes Skills cost zero and exhaust when played. Powers retain their current cost.
In a long fight, inspect hand and draw pile and compare Barricade setup before Corruption. Corruption does not immediately exhaust retained Skills.
rules.conditions: Runic Pyramid confirmed, Barricade not active; evaluate energy, incoming damage and skill reserve. This is not a mandatory card order.

rules.statement: Headbutt returns a card from discard to the top of draw. Confirm an eligible discard target; a sorted pile listing does not prove draw order.
True Grit exhausts a random other hand card; True Grit+ chooses. Verify upgrade and remaining hand before choosing an exhaust.
Before End Turn review all playable zero-cost cards, damage, safety and card-count limits. Body Slam uses current Block plus applicable attack modifiers.
Review confirmed potions before spending HP or ending a dangerous turn. Record observed consumption immediately; Fairy in a Bottle triggers automatically.

When HP is below half, treat optional fights and costly events as risk-budget decisions. Prefer a reachable rest site, use confirmed healing or defensive potions before lethal turns, and spend merchant gold on clearly identified survival or consistency upgrades rather than hoarding for an uncertain future shop.
rules.conditions: Current HP, enemy intent, potion effects, route and merchant offers must be visible. A low-HP threshold does not automatically mean skipping a card reward: take a clearly identified defensive card when its immediate survival value exceeds its deck cost.

rules.statement: Every twelfth played card resolves then ends the player turn; Time Eater gains 2 Strength. Counter persists across ordinary turns. Potions do not count.
Once per fight, going strictly below half HP queues Haste for the following turn. It heals to half HP and removes debuffs; current intent still resolves.
Displayed intent already includes visible damage modifiers. Do not multiply it by Vulnerable again. Recompute from verified raw per-hit values only when modifiers change.
Eternal Feather heals 3 per 5 deck cards on rest-site entry; Pantograph heals 25 at boss start. Do not count entry healing twice. Compare Rest with Smith.

Observed base Anger is a 0-cost Attack dealing 6 base damage and creating a copy in the combat discard pile. Observe after play; record the original play and generated copy separately, without changing permanent deck inventory.
rules.conditions: Base Anger was inspected in this run; unsupported variants require separate review.

rules.statement: Observed Hemokinesis+ is a 1-cost Attack that loses 2 HP and deals 20 base damage. Block does not pay its HP cost. Require more than 2 HP and observe after the play.
rules.conditions: Upgraded green-title card confirmed in this run; do not silently substitute base or modified card effects.

rules.statement: At Ascension 2, Spike Slime (L) Flame Tackle attacks for 18 base damage and adds 2 Slimed to discard; Lick applies 2 Frail. Spike Slime (M) Flame Tackle attacks for 10 and adds 1 Slimed; Lick applies 1 Frail. Use displayed modified damage and current visible intent, not a predicted move.
rules.conditions: Reviewed community reference for Slay the Spire 1, Ascension 2 only. Confirm identity, intent and resulting status changes on the live console.

rules.statement: Spike Slime (L) at or below half HP changes intent to Split and produces two smaller slimes with its current HP. Any threshold-crossing attack requires a new observation before using an incoming-damage prediction. Observe actual child identities, HP and intents; Spike Slime (M) has no Split.
rules.conditions: Current large-slime Split tooltip must be inspected; transformations and child state are observation boundaries.

rules.statement: In Slay the Spire 1, Slimed is a playable 1-cost Status whose effect is Exhaust. It has no card-draw effect. Observe and log the move to the combat exhaust pile when played.
rules.conditions: Confirm current card title, type, cost, playability and Exhaust text on drawing it; unrelated exhaust triggers remain separate.

rules.statement: Power Through+ adds two Wounds to hand and grants 20 base Block. Apply current Dexterity and Frail only to its card Block. Stop to observe generated statuses; unreviewed hand overflow cannot be predicted.
rules.conditions: Exact reviewed current-run variant only; fresh state and observed costs still required.

rules.statement: Base Metallicize adds 3 Metallicize. A confirmed active intensity grants that much Block at end of turn, unaffected by Frail, Dexterity or Panic Button’s card-only No Block. Playing the Power is an observation boundary.
rules.conditions: Exact reviewed current-run variant only; fresh state and observed costs still required.

rules.statement: Base Uppercut deals 13 base damage, then applies 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable. Damage does not benefit from its own new Vulnerable. Observe debuff and Artifact outcomes before replanning.
rules.conditions: Exact reviewed current-run variant only; fresh state and observed costs still required.

rules.statement: Base Warcry draws one card, then puts a selected hand card on top of draw, and exhausts. Observe the new hand before choosing; a pre-draw selection or sorted pile cannot establish its outcome.
rules.conditions: Exact reviewed current-run variant only; fresh state and observed costs still required.

rules.statement: Base Spot Weakness grants 3 Strength only if its selected enemy currently intends to attack. Require a living target and a visible attack; inspect the resulting Strength before another play.
rules.conditions: Exact reviewed current-run variant only; fresh state and observed costs still required.

rules.statement: Every third Attack played within a turn gains 1 Strength. Track a confirmed current-turn counter from 0 to 2. The third attack ends the checked line so Strength and the reset counter can be observed; Skills, Powers and potions do not count as played Attacks. Creating a copy does not count as playing an Attack; an Attack copy counts when played.
rules.conditions: Exact reviewed current-run variant only; fresh state and observed costs still required.

rules.statement: Red Mask applies 1 Weak to all enemies at combat start. Use the actually observed Weak and Artifact after resolution; do not reapply it from inventory or grant it to later summons.
rules.conditions: Exact reviewed current-run variant only; fresh state and observed costs still required.

rules.statement: Potion Belt grants two potion slots when acquired and has no card-resolution trigger. Complete observed potion inventory remains required; never infer empty or occupied slots from the relic alone.
rules.conditions: Exact reviewed current-run variant only; fresh state and observed costs still required.

rules.statement: The observed bottle deals 10 damage to all enemies, without spending energy or counting as a card. Immediate damage requires a complete current target roster plus explicit damage-modifier/reaction evidence. Stop and observe consumption, HP/Block and deaths before continuing.
rules.conditions: User-read current tooltip and reconciled historical inventory; Sacred Bark and other unreviewed modifiers are unsupported.

rules.statement: Use the reviewed A2 reference only after current boss and minion identities, full roster, moves and displayed hits are observed. Only an attack-only Fireball/Tackle turn has an unchanged displayed hit sum. Spawn, Revive, Buff and Mega Debuff need an enemy-action-order model; do not infer survival from the pre-action hit sum.
rules.conditions: A2 only. Community references; console behavior and disputed raw attack scaling are not independently verified.

behavior: After the opening, repeat Flail, Boost, Flail, Boost, Hyper Beam, then Stunned (A0–18) or Boost (A19+).

Strength applies to each hit. Orbs attack for base 8, give Automaton 12 Block or use Stasis once to capture an eligible highest-rarity draw card (discard if draw empty); killing an Orb returns its card. Do not predict a specific stolen card.
Source conflict: use A4 Boost Strength upgrade from boss table and extracted statistics, not standalone Strength wiki A9 claim.

behavior: Reverberate is three hits; at most twice consecutively. Head Slam and Ripple cannot repeat consecutively.
Head Slam reduces next-turn draw by one; A19+ adds two Slimed to discard. Ripple gains 20 Block, applies one Weak and Vulnerable, plus Frail at A19+.
Haste is strictly below half HP, once per fight, on the following turn; it does not interrupt current intent. Heals to half and removes debuffs.
Time Warp counts cards, including zero-cost cards and Powers, but not potions. The twelfth resolves, then ends the turn and adds 2 Strength before an ensuing attack.

The Collector.provenance: Community reference and fan game-extracted database; not official. Current console boss has not yet been entered.

variants.opening: Reference: Spawn two Torch Heads; confirm actual current intent and later roster.
timeline: Other actions are conditional; never infer the next rolled move.
variants.next_high_threat: Use observed complete Collector/Torch Head attack intents. Buff, Mega Debuff and summons invalidate unchanged-hit survival reasoning.
source_conflicts: The fan database calls Fireball A2+ 21 but its own scaling text assigns Rake 21 at A4+. Do not use either label to overwrite observed damage.

behavior: Community reference describes opening Spawn, a turn-four Mega Debuff, possible replacement summons, team Strength and boss Block. This is preparation information, not observed current turn state.
Retain distinct target IDs for both Torch Heads; after any death or summon re-observe the complete roster. Never infer a single enemy from a cropped view.

Mega Debuff can alter player Weak/Frail/Vulnerable and Buff changes team Strength. Those turns remain outside the unchanged displayed-intent forecast; no probabilities or unobserved move are substituted.
